item.title: Landmark trial accusing social media companies of addicting children to their platforms begins
item.description: LOS ANGELES — The world’s biggest social media companies face several landmark trials this year that seek to hold them responsible for harms to children who use their platforms. Opening statements in one such trial in Los Angeles County Superior Court began on Monday.

item.title: US stocks drift higher as gold, silver, bitcoin stabilize
item.description: NEW YORK — U.S. stocks drifted higher on Monday following big rallies for markets in Asia earlier in the day.

item.title: US and Canadian women eager to renew their fierce hockey rivalry at Milan Cortina Games
item.description: MILAN (AP) — Kelly Pannek couldn’t stop laughing, watching on TV when all heck broke loose during the U.S.-Canada game at the NHL’s 4 Nations Face-Off a year ago.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn says she has complex tibia fracture requiring multiple surgeries after Olympic crash
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy (AP) — Lindsey Vonn sustained a “complex tibia fracture that is currently stable but will require multiple surgeries to fix properly” after her devastating crash in the Olympic downhill, the skier said in a social media post late Monday.

item.title: Olympics Roundup: 2 golds in 3 days for Swiss skier Franjo von Allmen at Olympics
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy (AP) — Swiss skier Franjo von Allmen won the first gold medal of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics over the weekend, and he added another on Day 3.

item.title: US reaches first Olympic curling mixed doubles final, will face Swedish siblings for gold
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy (AP) — Korey Dropkin whooped and hollered and directed a string of fist pumps to a small pocket of American curling fans chanting “U-S-A! U-S-A!”

item.title: Local Roundup: Pittston Area girls fend off Wyoming Area in Tigue-Denisco Memorial Game
item.description: Bella Dessoye led all scorers with 15 points and earned team MVP honors as the Pittston Area girls basketball team defeated Wyoming Area 50-27 in the annual Tigue-Denisco Memorial game between the two rivals.

item.title: North Dakota State, winner of 10 FCS titles, jumps to FBS to join Mountain West in football
item.description: Perennial FCS power North Dakota State will move up to the FBS this season and join the Mountain West for football, confident that sustained success at the previous two levels can continue behind a hefty new investment in the program.

item.title: David Mills: Illegal immigrants make us money
item.description: America’s largest libertarian think tank just produced a study that blows up the Trump administration’s claims about the horrible economic damage immigrants are doing.

item.title: Editorial: Of course Trump will try to sabotage the midterms. But voters aren’t helpless
item.description: Maya Angelou’s often-quoted advice — When someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time— is quoted so often because it’s so obviously true.
